title: Average Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The average velocity of the molecules must be calculated correctly using the ideal gas equation.

title: Rotational Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The average rotational velocity must be derived correctly using the moment of inertia and rotational kinetic energy.

title: Heat Capacities
description: Essential Criteria: The molar heat capacities C_P and C_v must be derived correctly based on the degrees of freedom.

title: Degrees of Freedom
description: Important Criteria: The number of translational and rotational degrees of freedom must be identified and applied correctly.

title: Moment of Inertia
description: Important Criteria: The moment of inertia for the H_2 molecule must be calculated correctly.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy and velocity.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas must be avoided.
